name: PK: Balance sheet total per VRG (PNR 800)
description: Formblatt 800: R800-800 (Bilanzwert) of every VRG, with the VRG's name and kind (PK.000.01).

name: PK: Market value per CIC category
description: List of Assets: market value (C1110PK) of the positions per VRG and CIC category (3rd character of the CIC in PK.006.02.01.02).

name: PK: Positions without ISIN
description: List of Assets: positions whose type of code (C0020PK) is not ISIN.
query:
for $p in /*/*[starts-with(name(), 'PK.006.02.01.01_')]/Datenpunkt[normalize-space(Wert_C0020PK) ne 'ISIN']
return string-join(('VRG ' || $p/../@VRG, normalize-space($p/Wert_C0010PK), normalize-space($p/Wert_C0020PK), normalize-space($p/Wert_C1120PK)), ' | ')

name: PK: Top 10 positions by balance sheet value
description: List of Assets: the ten largest positions (C1100PK) over all VRG, with their name from PK.006.02.01.02.
query:
let $info := /*/*[starts-with(name(), 'PK.006.02.01.02_')]/Datenpunkt
let $top := (for $p in /*/*[starts-with(name(), 'PK.006.02.01.01_')]/Datenpunkt[Wert_C1100PK castable as xs:decimal]
  order by xs:decimal($p/Wert_C1100PK) descending
  return $p)[position() le 10]
for $p in $top
return string-join(('VRG ' || $p/../@VRG, normalize-space($p/Wert_C0010PK), normalize-space(($info[../@VRG = $p/../@VRG][Wert_C0010PK = $p/Wert_C0010PK]/Wert_C0130)[1]), format-number(xs:decimal($p/Wert_C1100PK), '#,##0.00')), ' | ')

name: PK: Not looked-through share per fund
description: Look-through (PK.006.03): per VRG and fund the market value, the part reported as category 4 (not looked through) and its share.

name: PK: Derivatives
description: Derivatives (PK.008.01.01.01) per VRG with their asset id and all reported fields.
query:
for $d in /*/*[starts-with(name(), 'PK.008.01.01.01_')]/Datenpunkt
return string-join(('VRG ' || $d/../@VRG, for $f in $d/*[starts-with(name(), 'Wert_')] return substring-after(name($f), 'Wert_') || '=' || normalize-space($f)), ' | ')
